description: The shared database where Hangfire or a Quartz.NET persistent store keeps jobs, schedules and their state, so every instance sees the same work.
A Hangfire job enqueued with `IBackgroundJobClient.Enqueue` that runs once, soon, on any server connected to the storage.
A job with a stable id and a cron expression, created or replaced with `IRecurringJobManager.AddOrUpdate`, evaluated in UTC unless a time zone is given.
Hangfire's global filter that retries a failed job, 10 attempts by default, before moving it to the `Failed` state.
Quartz.NET's split between the `IJob` that does the work and the triggers (simple or cron) that decide when it fires.
Quartz.NET nodes sharing a persistent store so that each trigger occurrence fires on exactly one node.
A Quartz.NET attribute that prevents a new run of a job from starting while the previous run is still executing.
